This is the Specification of an Industrial network distribution switch we are after:
Industrial Network Switch Specification Based on SparX-5i Family
1. General Characteristics:
© Type: Industrial Network Switch
‧ Chipset: SparX-5i family
‧ Mounting: Din-Rail mountable or standalone for wall hanging
© Environment: Suitable for underground hardrock mining environments
‧ Operating Temperature: -40°C to +75°C
。 Vibration and Shock Resistance: Compliant with IEC 60068-2-6 and IEC 60068-2-27 standards
2. Ports and Interfaces:
‧ 10Gbps Ports: 4 x SFP+ 10Gbps (2 dedicated in-band and 2 dedicated out-of-band)
‧ 1/2.5Gbps Ports: 8 x 1/2.5Gbps Single Mode LC connectors or 1/2.5Gbps SFP interfaces
‧ Console Port: 1 x RJ45 Console for CLI Access
